name: Guggenheim Museum Bilbao
notes: Frank Gehry's museum (1997) on the south bank of the Nervión, the river to the north. The titanium is modelled in SketchUp (scripts/sketchup/guggenheim_bilbao.py; sketchup/guggenheim-bilbao.skp) and read back as meshes: the 50 m atrium as a leaning, twisting bundle with a glass crown, seven curling sails round it (tallest on the river side), four galleries as leaning lofted volumes with rolled tops, the 130 m 'fish' gallery along the river with upright walls and a rolling roof and a fin over it, its tail swelling up under La Salve bridge, and the titanium cap on the stone tower. The straight parts are ordinary parts: the limestone blocks on the city side, the glass walls to the river, the pool, the river, La Salve bridge with Buren's red arch, the plaza and Puppy. Footprint from the OpenStreetMap ground; the atrium's height and the gallery's length from the museum's own description. Guessed: every curve's exact lean, twist and radius, the stone blocks' heights. No photographs were available; refine from photographs.
